Picked GZCLP: GZCLP is the standing default for a 3-4 day barbell strength goal past the absolute-novice stage: double progression with a proven T1/T2/T3 shape. T1 Barbell Squat starts at 140 lb (from 185x5, e1RM 187 lb after form allowance).

Day A1 (squat T1, bench T2) - 3 exercises. T1 Barbell Squat 5x3, AMRAP last set; T2 Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip 3x10; T3 Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown 3x15, AMRAP last set\nReadiness 1-5? (skip if you like)
